parameters.name: EMLMRSupport
parameters.description: Indicates if the Enhanced Multi-Link Multi-Radio (EMLMR) operation is supported by this STA MLD.

parameters.name: EMLSRSupport
parameters.description: Indicates if Enhanced Multi-Link Single-Radio (EMLSR) operation is supported by this STA MLD.

parameters.name: STRSupport
parameters.description: Indicates if Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (STR) operation is supported by this STA MLD.

parameters.name: NSTRSupport
parameters.description: Indicates if Non-Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (NSTR) operation is supported by this STA MLD.

parameters.name: TIDLinkMapNegotiation
parameters.description: Indicates if Traffic Identifier (TID) to Link Mapping Negotiation is supported by this STA MLD.

object.description: This object describes the Wi-Fi 7 capabilities for this STA MLD including Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capabilities. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} Source: Wi-Fi 7 Agent Capabilities TLV.
